data.name: Rajith
data.gender_notes: Rajith is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Rajith is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Raj' which means 'King' or 'Ruler'. This name is associated with the sun and represents power, authority and leadership. The name Rajith carries the meaning “King, Ruler, Sun” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Sanskrit, Tamil, Telugu. Parents who choose Rajith usually hope their child will grow to embody king, ruler, sun and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Rajith is a divine name that signifies the presence of the supreme ruler within an individual. It bestows upon the bearer the strength, courage and wisdom to rule over his own destiny.
data.etymology: Rajith belongs to the Hindu linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “King, Ruler, Sun.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Rajith total 3, giving a life-path number of 3. Number 3 is linked with Jupiter and with the qualities of creativity, expression and optimism.

data.cultural_impact: In Hindu culture, the name Rajith holds a strong significance as it is associated with royalty, power and authority. It is often given to babies as a symbol of their potential to rule and lead in their future lives. In Hindu mythology, there are several kings and rulers who bear this name, reflecting the importance of leadership and power in Hindu culture.
data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual perspective, the name Rajith signifies the innate divine ruler within each one of us. It encourages us to tap into our inner power and authority and act as the masters of our own lives. The name also symbolizes the sun god, representng the source of all light, consciousness, and life in the universe. Therefore, Rajith reminds us of the power of the divine and the importance of cultivating inner strength and wisdom.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Rajith, meaning 'ruler of the mind,' signifies one who has mastered their thoughts and emotions, embodying inner strength and wisdom. This name is a reminder of the power within to rule over the external world.
